scope: One record per observed sampled GPU batch, including mixed cohorts once. Native per-layer/pre-forward waits include instrumentation overhead. First FULL means first observed FULL dependency, not global layer zero. GPU spans include kernels and CPU launch gaps, not exclusive computation. Offsets are relative compute-stream events, not absolute H2D positions or load-fence wait. No sample expansion, per-request stall allocation, oracle prefetch lead, removable JCT, or isolated speedup is inferred.
